title: Stockfish, But It Plays for 0.00 Evaluation
summary: 'Drawfish': an engine that plays whatever move brings the evaluation closest to 0.00. Player (white, London setup) realizes the bot will never take an advantage and also won't recapture if the recapture makes it 'too winning'; the plan is to win small material (a pawn) in simplified positions where the bot prefers equality, trade into an endgame, promote, and finally mate with Rh5# after a waiting move forces Kh7. Won game 1.
rules: Each bot move: evaluate all legal moves; play the one whose resulting evaluation is closest to 0.00 (absolute value), regardless of whether it favours the bot.
Official site: ties broken toward the higher-ranked engine move.
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1 (Rh5#).
